config.label: Bags API key from dev
config.description: Bags API key from dev.bags.fm. Required for all tools.

config.label: Solana cluster: devnet (default) or mainnet
config.description: Solana cluster: devnet (default) or mainnet. Writes on mainnet move real funds.

config.label: Custom Solana RPC endpoint
config.description: Custom Solana RPC endpoint. Defaults to the public RPC for BAGS_NETWORK.

config.label: Path to a Solana keypair JSON file
config.description: Path to a Solana keypair JSON file. Only required for write tools.

config.label: Hard cap on SOL spent by any single transaction
config.description: Hard cap on SOL spent by any single transaction. Default 0.1.

config.label: Hard cap on total SOL spent across one server session
config.description: Hard cap on total SOL spent across one server session. Default 1.0.

config.label: Set true to skip the two-step confirmation on writes
config.description: Set true to skip the two-step confirmation on writes. Default false.

config.label: Mint address of the BOS token used for gating write tools
config.description: Mint address of the BOS token used for gating write tools.

config.label: Minimum BOS balance required to call write tools
config.description: Minimum BOS balance required to call write tools. Default 10000.

config.label: Permit non-SOL-input swaps, which the SOL-denominated caps cannot limit
config.description: Permit non-SOL-input swaps, which the SOL-denominated caps cannot limit.

config.label: Makes bags_get_claimable_fees return fabricated data instead of calling the API
config.description: Makes bags_get_claimable_fees return fabricated data instead of calling the API. Default false.
